items.changed: The column "Equitable share reported" is now two columns: the equitable share the county was allocated, and the amount it received. The figures themselves have not changed; each year is now filed under the measure the Controller of Budget's report gives.
items.reason: The one column mixed two measures: it showed the allocation in seven years (FY2013/14, 2014/15, 2018/19, 2019/20, 2021/22, 2023/24 and 2024/25) and the amount received in five. In FY2021/22, for example, it showed the KSh 5.14 billion allocation; the report says the county received KSh 4.72 billion.
